entries.summary: Head of the aristocratic Eldrich family business dynasty and of Eldrich Corporation, successor to the Eldrich Colonial Shipping Corporation. The richest citizen of Ukweli and a globally dominant shipping magnate: an extremely eccentric, flamboyant publicity seeker, serial inventor and promoter of improbable products, some genuinely original and others arguably stolen or appropriated. Publicly meddles in politics, funds the Libertarian party and sympathetic media, and is obsessed with colonising Mars.

entries.gm_notes: Play the contradictions, not a villain: aristocratic pedigree against anti-establishment branding, monopolistic market power against free-market rhetoric, local philanthropy and jobs against elite capture, flamboyant imagination against possible AI/NHI/PSI encounters. He is neither one-dimensional nor omnipotent.
